\section[kaṭal]{\ml{കടൽ} (kaṭal) — the sea}

\label{lesson:ML-C136-sea}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a bridge, then the Malayalam for a village.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{കടൽ}}
\textbf{\ml{കടൽ}} (\emph{kaṭal}) — \textquotedblleft{}the sea\textquotedblright{}. Kerala's whole west side is on it.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
Where the fish come from.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kaṭal}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kaṭal}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{kaṭal}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a bridge, then the Malayalam for a village, then say \emph{kaṭal} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{കടൽ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}The sea\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
